app.name: When do we go?
app.tagline: Find the dates for your group trip.
app.subtitle: Find dates for your group trip

common.demoBanner: Demo – please don’t enter real data.

landing.lead: Everyone adds when they can. We find the dates when everyone is free.
landing.step1Text: Share the link in your group chat
landing.invitedText: Just open the link from your group chat.

auth.loginLead: Enter your email. We’ll send you a code – no password needed.
auth.rememberMeInline: You’ll stay signed in on this device.
auth.magicHint: Tapped the link in the email? Then you’ll continue in the other browser. You can enter the code here instead.
auth.nameTitle: Almost there! What should the others call you?
auth.newHere: New here? Just enter your email – we’ll create your account automatically.
auth.spamHint: No email? Check your spam folder.

errors.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address, e.g. name@example.com.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. We’ll send you a new code.
errors.expired: This code has expired. Just request a new one.
errors.rateLimited: Please wait a moment before requesting a new code.
errors.generic: No connection. Your input is still here – please try again.

magic.title: Sign in
magic.heading: Almost there!
magic.lead: Tap the button to sign in on this browser.
magic.otherAccount: You’re currently signed in as {name}. This link will sign you in as someone else.
magic.invalidHeading: This sign-in link no longer works
magic.invalid: It’s valid for 15 minutes and works only once. Just get a new code.
magic.failed: That didn’t work. Please try again.

invite.title: Invitation
invite.memberCount: {count, plural, one {# person is already in} other {# people are already in}}

invite.emailTitle: Join in seconds with your email.

trips.title: My trips
trips.emptyText: Create one and share the link in your group chat – or open the invite link you received.

motion.label: Reduce motion
motion.help: Fewer animations, no confetti, no vibration. Content simply fades in.
motion.off: Off: we follow your device setting.
motion.device: On because your device reduces motion. You can change this in your device settings.
